title: edge and checkout failures for paying customers
initial_symptoms: The edge API and checkout both return errors for paying customers
Orders fail before a receipt is issued

required_evidence.description: traces show the payment span consuming most of the checkout budget
checkout logs show a downstream request deadline was exceeded
gateway and checkout error rates rise together

forbidden_shortcuts: restart the gateway without a trace comparison
scale checkout because the edge API is also failing

allowed_remediations.description: shed checkout payment traffic after confirming the downstream deadline

recovery_checks.description: payment charge finishes inside the checkout budget

prompt_variants: Paying customers are seeing failures at the edge API and during checkout.
